message:
## Vulnerability Digest

**Scan window:** 20 November 2026, 23:40 UTC to 21 November 2026, 23:40 UTC (22 November, 05:10 IST). **Scope:** Products.txt only, with naming variations normalized and duplicates removed, plus the mandatory MongoDB ecosystem sweep.

No newly reported, credibly verified vulnerabilities matching the monitored products were identified within this exact 24-hour window. This is not proof that no vulnerabilities exist: search indexing and publication timestamps can limit coverage.

**MongoDB ecosystem:** Checked MongoDB security alerts and searched for Server, Community and Enterprise, mongod and mongos, Atlas and services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, database tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm and App Services, official libraries and integrations, and MongoDB-owned advisories without MongoDB in their titles. The MongoDB C# and Java driver CVEs CVE-2026-129938 and CVE-2026-129932 were published on 19 November, outside this window, and are not presented as new findings. [MongoDB alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts); [C# driver advisory](https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-csharp-driver/security/advisories/GHSA-6cg8-fvx8-vvmm).

**Closing:** No immediate review is recommended on the basis of a new finding in this scan. Continue existing remediation for previously disclosed issues; this result does not imply that older critical vulnerabilities have been resolved.
